observation.title: API reference — Runeforge
observation.visible_text: Runeforge v3.4 Search docs ⌘K v3.4 (latest) v3.3 v3.2 v2 (legacy) ☾ ★ 18.4k REFERENCE Overview forge() derive() use() · middleware asyncSlice() listSlice() formSlice() devtools() REACT ADAPTER useStore() useSnapshot() <Provider /> (optional) ERRORS RF001 — RF019 OTHER Docs home Quickstart Examples Docs › API reference Reference · v3.4 API reference. Every public symbol in runeforge and @runeforge/react. Re-export-only modules (runeforge/devtools, runeforge/utils) are linked at the bottom. FUNCTION forge(definition, options?) Available since v1.0 · Updated in v3.0 (action signature) Creates a store from a definition object. The shape of definition.state and definition.actions is inferred — TypeScript users get full autocomplete and type-checking with no extra annotations. SIGNATURE function forge<S, A>( definition: { state: S; actions: A }, options?: { name?: string; persist?: boolean | PersistConfig } ): Store<S, A>; PARAMETERS NAME TYPE DESCRIPTION definition.state Object Initial state. Must be a plain object (or a value compatible with structuredClone). definition.actions Map<string, fn> Map of action functions. Each receives state as its first argument and may take any number of additional arguments. options.name string Override the auto-derived debug name. Visible in devtools and persisted storage keys. options.persist boolean | PersistConfig Persist this store to localStorage (or a custom adapter). See Persistence. RETURNS A Store<S, A> object with get(), set(), subscribe(), select(), reset(), toJSON(), fromJSON(), and all your action methods at the top level. EXAMPLE const counter = forge({ state: { count: 0, step: 1 }, actions: { inc: (s) => ({ count: s.count + s.step }), setStep: (s, step: number) => ({ step }), }, }, { name: "counter", persist: true }); Version history FUNCTION derive(inputs, fn) Available since v2.0 Creates a derived store from one or more input stores. fn runs only when at least one input has changed, and the result is shallow-compared before notifying subscribers — so identical outputs don't emit. SIGNATURE function derive<Inputs extends Store[], Out>( inputs: [...Inputs], fn: (...states: { [K in keyof Inputs]: StoreState<Inputs[K]> }) => Out ): DerivedStore<Out>; EXAMPLE const visibleTodos = derive([todos, filter], (t, f) => f.mode === "done" ? t.items.filter(x => x.done) : t.items ); Don't subscribe inside fn. A derive function must be pure and synchronous. Side effects (logging, fetching, subscribing) belong in an effect. FUNCTION use(middleware) Available since v2.4 Installs an action-level middleware. Middleware wrap every committed action across every store. Use this for logging, devtools, persistence, time-travel. function use(mw: (next: Dispatch) => Dispatch): () => void; use((next) => (action, args) => { console.log("→", action.name, args); return next(action, args); }); Calling use() returns a function that uninstalls the middleware. Middleware run in install order. HELPER asyncSlice<T>(options?) Available since v3.0 Returns { status, data, error } with the right types for async state. Designed to be spread into state alongside your own fields. const user = forge({ state: { ...asyncSlice<User>(), lastFetch: 0 }, actions: { /* … */ }, }); HELPER listSlice<T>() Available since v3.1 Returns a state + actions pair for a keyed collection. The action set covers the common CRUD operations. { state: { items: T[] }, actions: (key: keyof T) => ListActions<T> } Generated actions: add, remove, replace, update, clear, byId, has, count. HELPER formSlice<T>() Available since v3.2 Adds values, errors, touched, submitting, and matching actions. Pair with a validation function for typed form state. MIDDLEWARE devtools(options?) Available since v1.0 Installs the Runeforge browser-devtools middleware. Renders an action log with diffs, supports "jump to" time-travel, and exposes per-store snapshots. devtools({ name: "My App", maxHistory: 200 }); React adapter (@runeforge/react) HOOK useStore(store, selector?,

observation.visible_text: Runeforge v3.4 Search docs ⌘K v3.4 (latest) v3.3 v3.2 v2 (legacy) ☾ ★ 18.4k REFERENCE Overview forge() derive() use() · middleware asyncSlice() listSlice() formSlice() devtools() REACT ADAPTER useStore() useSnapshot() <Provider /> (optional) ERRORS RF001 — RF019 OTHER Docs home Quickstart Examples Docs › API reference Reference · v3.4 API reference. Every public symbol in runeforge and @runeforge/react. Re-export-only modules (runeforge/devtools, runeforge/utils) are linked at the bottom. FUNCTION forge(definition, options?) Available since v1.0 · Updated in v3.0 (action signature) Creates a store from a definition object. The shape of definition.state and definition.actions is inferred — TypeScript users get full autocomplete and type-checking with no extra annotations. SIGNATURE function forge<S, A>( definition: { state: S; actions: A }, options?: { name?: string; persist?: boolean | PersistConfig } ): Store<S, A>; PARAMETERS NAME TYPE DESCRIPTION definition.state Object Initial state. Must be a plain object (or a value compatible with structuredClone). definition.actions Map<string, fn> Map of action functions. Each receives state as its first argument and may take any number of additional arguments. options.name string Override the auto-derived debug name. Visible in devtools and persisted storage keys. options.persist boolean | PersistConfig Persist this store to localStorage (or a custom adapter). See Persistence. RETURNS A Store<S, A> object with get(), set(), subscribe(), select(), reset(), toJSON(), fromJSON(), and all your action methods at the top level. EXAMPLE const counter = forge({ state: { count: 0, step: 1 }, actions: { inc: (s) => ({ count: s.count + s.step }), setStep: (s, step: number) => ({ step }), }, }, { name: "counter", persist: true }); Version history FUNCTION derive(inputs, fn) Available since v2.0 Creates a derived store from one or more input stores. fn runs only when at least one input has changed, and the result is shallow-compared before notifying subscribers — so identical outputs don't emit. SIGNATURE function derive<Inputs extends Store[], Out>( inputs: [...Inputs], fn: (...states: { [K in keyof Inputs]: StoreState<Inputs[K]> }) => Out ): DerivedStore<Out>; EXAMPLE const visibleTodos = derive([todos, filter], (t, f) => f.mode === "done" ? t.items.filter(x => x.done) : t.items ); Don't subscribe inside fn. A derive function must be pure and synchronous. Side effects (logging, fetching, subscribing) belong in an effect. FUNCTION use(middleware) Available since v2.4 Installs an action-level middleware. Middleware wrap every committed action across every store. Use this for logging, devtools, persistence, time-travel. function use(mw: (next: Dispatch) => Dispatch): () => void; use((next) => (action, args) => { console.log("→", action.name, args); return next(action, args); }); Calling use() returns a function that uninstalls the middleware. Middleware run in install order. HELPER asyncSlice<T>(options?) Available since v3.0 Returns { status, data, error } with the right types for async state. Designed to be spread into state alongside your own fields. const user = forge({ state: { ...asyncSlice<User>(), lastFetch: 0 }, actions: { /* … */ }, }); HELPER listSlice<T>() Available since v3.1 Returns a state + actions pair for a keyed collection. The action set covers the common CRUD operations. { state: { items: T[] }, actions: (key: keyof T) => ListActions<T> } Generated actions: add, remove, replace, update, clear, byId, has, count. HELPER formSlice<T>() Available since v3.2 Adds values, errors, touched, submitting, and matching actions. Pair with a validation function for typed form state. MIDDLEWARE devtools(options?) Available since v1.0 Installs the Runeforge browser-devtools middleware. Renders an action log with diffs, supports "jump to" time-travel, and exposes per-store snapshots. devtools({ name: "My App", maxHistory: 200 }); React adapter (@runeforge/react) HOOK useStore(store, selector?,

Every public symbol in runeforge and @runeforge/react. Re-export-only modules (runeforge/devtools, runeforge/utils) are linked at the bottom. FUNCTION forge(definition, options?) Available since v1.0 · Updated in v3.0 (action signature) Creates a store from a definition object. The shape of definition.state and definition.actions is inferred — TypeScript users get full autocomplete and type-checking with no extra annotations. SIGNATURE function forge<S, A>( definition: { state: S; actions: A }, options?: { name?: string; persist?: boolean | PersistConfig } ): Store<S, A>; PARAMETERS NAME TYPE DESCRIPTION definition.state Object Initial state. Must be a plain object (or a value compatible with structuredClone). definition.actions Map<string, fn> Map of action functions. Each receives state as its first argument and may take any number of additional arguments. options.name string Override the auto-derived debug name. Visible in devtools and persisted storage keys. options.persist boolean | PersistConfig Persist this store to localStorage (or a custom adapter). See Persistence. RETURNS A Store<S, A> object with get(), set(), subscribe(), select(), reset(), toJSON(), fromJSON(), and all your action methods at the top level. EXAMPLE const counter = forge({ state: { count: 0, step: 1 }, actions: { inc: (s) => ({ count: s.count + s.step }), setStep: (s, step: number) => ({ step }), }, }, { name: "counter", persist: true }); Version history FUNCTION derive(inputs, fn) Available since v2.0 Creates a derived store from one or more input stores. fn runs only when at least one input has changed, and the result is shallow-compared before notifying subscribers — so identical outputs don't emit. SIGNATURE function derive<Inputs extends Store[], Out>( inputs: [...Inputs], fn: (...states: { [K in keyof Inputs]: StoreState<Inputs[K]> }) => Out ): DerivedStore<Out>; EXAMPLE const visibleTodos = derive([todos, filter], (t, f) => f.mode === "done" ? t.items.filter(x => x.done) : t.items ); Don't subscribe inside fn. A derive function must be pure and synchronous. Side effects (logging, fetching, subscribing) belong in an effect. FUNCTION use(middleware) Available since v2.4 Installs an action-level middleware. Middleware wrap every committed action across every store. Use this for logging, devtools, persistence, time-travel. function use(mw: (next: Dispatch) => Dispatch): () => void; use((next) => (action, args) => { console.log("→", action.name, args); return next(action, args); }); Calling use() returns a function that uninstalls the middleware. Middleware run in install order. HELPER asyncSlice<T>(options?) Available since v3.0 Returns { status, data, error } with the right types for async state. Designed to be spread into state alongside your own fields. const user = forge({ state: { ...asyncSlice<User>(), lastFetch: 0 }, actions: { /* … */ }, }); HELPER listSlice<T>() Available since v3.1 Returns a state + actions pair for a keyed collection. The action set covers the common CRUD operations. { state: { items: T[] }, actions: (key: keyof T) => ListActions<T> } Generated actions: add, remove, replace, update, clear, byId, has, count. HELPER formSlice<T>() Available since v3.2 Adds values, errors, touched, submitting, and matching actions. Pair with a validation function for typed form state. MIDDLEWARE devtools(options?) Available since v1.0 Installs the Runeforge browser-devtools middleware. Renders an action log with diffs, supports "jump to" time-travel, and exposes per-store snapshots. devtools({ name: "My App", maxHistory: 200 }); React adapter (@runeforge/react) HOOK useStore(store, selector?,

EXAMPLE const counter = forge({ state: { count: 0, step: 1 }, actions: { inc: (s) => ({ count: s.count + s.step }), setStep: (s, step: number) => ({ step }), }, }, { name: "counter", persist: true }); Version history FUNCTION derive(inputs, fn) Available since v2.0 Creates a derived store from one or more input stores. fn runs only when at least one input has changed, and the result is shallow-compared before notifying subscribers — so identical outputs don't emit. SIGNATURE function derive<Inputs extends Store[], Out>( inputs: [...Inputs], fn: (...states: { [K in keyof Inputs]: StoreState<Inputs[K]> }) => Out ): DerivedStore<Out>; EXAMPLE const visibleTodos = derive([todos, filter], (t, f) => f.mode === "done" ? t.items.filter(x => x.done) : t.items ); Don't subscribe inside fn. A derive function must be pure and synchronous. Side effects (logging, fetching, subscribing) belong in an effect. FUNCTION use(middleware) Available since v2.4 Installs an action-level middleware. Middleware wrap every committed action across every store. Use this for logging, devtools, persistence, time-travel. function use(mw: (next: Dispatch) => Dispatch): () => void; use((next) => (action, args) => { console.log("→", action.name, args); return next(action, args); }); Calling use() returns a function that uninstalls the middleware. Middleware run in install order. HELPER asyncSlice<T>(options?) Available since v3.0 Returns { status, data, error } with the right types for async state. Designed to be spread into state alongside your own fields. const user = forge({ state: { ...asyncSlice<User>(), lastFetch: 0 }, actions: { /* … */ }, }); HELPER listSlice<T>() Available since v3.1 Returns a state + actions pair for a keyed collection. The action set covers the common CRUD operations. { state: { items: T[] }, actions: (key: keyof T) => ListActions<T> } Generated actions: add, remove, replace, update, clear, byId, has, count. HELPER formSlice<T>() Available since v3.2 Adds values, errors, touched, submitting, and matching actions. Pair with a validation function for typed form state. MIDDLEWARE devtools(options?) Available since v1.0 Installs the Runeforge browser-devtools middleware. Renders an action log with diffs, supports "jump to" time-travel, and exposes per-store snapshots. devtools({ name: "My App", maxHistory: 200 }); React adapter (@runeforge/react) HOOK useStore(store, selector?,
